configure_google_api_key: configure the google generativeai client with an API key from an environment variable or explicit value
call_gemini_pro: call the gemini-pro model with a text prompt and return the generated response as a string
call_gemini_with_retry: call the google generative AI API with automatic retry using exponential backoff up to six attempts
call_gemini_with_vision: call the gemini-pro-vision model with text and PIL Image inputs to get a multimodal response
run_google_api_cli: run the module directly to configure the API key and send a sample prompt to gemini-pro
